subtopics.title: Question One — Concepts and Cost Sorting

questions.question: The supervisor's salary in a factory is classified as:
options: Indirect labour — a factory overhead serving the factory as a whole
Direct labour — part of prime cost

questions.question: Under the perpetual inventory system:
options: Stock is only counted at year-end
Cost of sales is recorded at every sale, keeping the stock account continuously current
Cost of sales is deduced from a periodic count

questions.question: Depreciation on delivery vehicles is sorted into:
options: Selling and distribution cost — delivery serves sales, not production

questions.question: A wrong placement in the sorting table usually costs extra marks because:
options: It must be rewritten in ink
The statement totals downstream inherit the misfiled cost

questions.question: Opening raw materials R60 000, purchases R540 000, carriage R12 000, closing R72 000. Direct materials issued:
options: R540 000 — opening plus purchases plus carriage minus closing

questions.question: Factory wages are R336 000 and employer's contributions R24 000. Direct labour cost is:
options: R360 000 — the contributions ride on the factory wages

questions.question: Rent of R40 000 is split seventy percent factory by floor area. The production cost statement receives:
options: R28 000 — the remainder goes to administration
Nothing — rent is never a factory cost

questions.question: Total cost of production R1 248 000, opening work-in-progress R52 000, closing R40 000, 21 000 units finished. Unit cost:
options: R60,00 — cost of production of finished goods R1 260 000 over 21 000

questions.question: Selling price R240, variable costs R150. The contribution per pair is:
options: R90 — and it must use variable costs only

questions.question: Fixed costs R630 000 over contribution R90 gives a break-even of:
Last year: 7 500 pairs produced against a break-even of 7 600. The correct comment is:
options: The factory was profitable by 100 pairs
The factory fell 100 pairs short of break-even and made a loss; this year's 1 200-pair margin is the improvement
Break-even cannot be compared across years

questions.question: Producing 1 200 pairs beyond break-even at a R90 contribution yields a profit of:
options: R108 000 — fixed costs are already covered, so each extra pair drops its full contribution

questions.question: Three thousand units were available; eight hundred remain; the last batch was one thousand units at R99. FIFO closing stock is:
options: R79 200 — the units remaining are the newest, all from the R99 batch

questions.question: Total cost R276 000 over three thousand units gives a weighted average of:
options: R92,00 — closing stock of eight hundred units at R73 600

questions.question: In a year of rising prices, FIFO compared to weighted average reports:
options: Lower closing stock and higher cost of sales
Higher closing stock, lower cost of sales, and therefore higher profit

questions.question: Eight hundred units on hand against sales of 2 200 a year is about 133 days of stock. The judgement depends on:
options: The sales rhythm — seasonal peaks may justify it; flat demand makes it sleeping capital and a theft risk

questions.question: October sales R220 000, forty percent cash. Cash sales receipts for October are:
September credit sales were R120 000, collected fifty percent the month after sale. October receives:
options: R60 000 — plus R48 600 from August's credit sales at forty-five percent

questions.question: The five percent of credit sales that turns bad appears in the cash budget:
options: As a receipt in the third month
Nowhere — bad debts move no cash; they belong to the projected income statement
As a note to the budget

questions.question: Budgeted advertising R10 000, actual R2 500, and sales fell short. The managerial comment is:
options: The underspend likely caused the shortfall — advertising is seed, not luxury; restore and monitor it

subtopics.title: The Reconciliation and Age Analysis Question

questions.question: Our payment of R12 000 made on the last day of the month is missing from the supplier's statement. The correction is:
options: Subtract R12 000 on the statement side — a timing difference

questions.question: The statement overcharges R300 against the agreed price. This is corrected by:
options: Subtracting R300 on the statement side — their error, their side

questions.question: An unrecorded debit note for returns of R2 500 is corrected by:
options: Subtracting R2 500 from our ledger — our omission, our side, reaching the agreed R63 800

questions.question: On thirty-day terms, R48 000 sits at sixty days and R24 000 at ninety-plus in a R240 000 book. A full-mark response includes:
options: Praising the forty percent that is current
Interest on arrears, suspending the oldest accounts, credit checks, early-settlement discounts — and separating cash receiving from ledger keeping

subtopics.title: The VAT, Internal Control and Ethics Question

questions.question: Sales of R720 000 excluding VAT produce output tax of:
The owner takes stock costing R6 000 excluding VAT. The settlement adjustment is:
options: Add R900 — the input claim on consumed goods must be returned

questions.question: A debtor owing R9 200 including VAT is written off. The vendor reclaims:
options: R1 380 — fifteen percent of the debt
Nothing — bad debts are not a VAT matter
R1 200 — fifteen over one hundred and fifteen, because the figure is inclusive

questions.question: A second till that lets cash sales bypass the record is best described as:
options: A private matter for the owner
VAT fraud and tax evasion — money held in trust for SARS is being stolen, and the understated records mislead every user
